tools.name: search_images
tools.description: Search the MemeStack image gallery. Runs semantic AI and keyword matching in parallel and merges results. Returns images with captions, tags, zap stats, and URLs.

tools.name: get_image
tools.description: Get full metadata for a specific image by ID, including caption, alt text, tags, OCR text, zap stats, and URLs.

tools.name: find_similar
tools.description: Find visually similar images using perceptual hash matching. Returns images that look alike.

tools.name: find_related
tools.description: Find semantically related images using AI embedding similarity. Returns images with similar meaning/topic.

tools.name: browse_images
tools.description: Browse and filter the image gallery without a search query. Useful for discovering content by tag, trending, or recent uploads.

tools.name: get_user_profile
tools.description: Get a user's public profile including display name, stats, and avatar info.

tools.name: get_leaderboard
tools.description: Get top-ranked images by zaps received, or top zappers by amount zapped, over a time period.

tools.name: browse_by_tag
tools.description: Browse images for a specific tag. Returns the tag profile (description, stats) and optionally a paginated list of images tagged with it.

tools.name: browse_by_category
tools.description: Get a category and its featured images. Categories group related tags (e.g. "charts", "memes", "lightning-network").

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List all available image categories. Use this to discover what categories exist before calling browse_by_category.

tools.name: get_tag_profile
tools.description: Get the profile for a tag (description, image count, total zaps, related tags) without fetching any images. Use browse_by_tag to also retrieve images.

tools.name: get_mutation_group
tools.description: Get all variants of a meme template tracked on MemeStack. Returns the dominant image plus every variant in the same mutation group, with citation blocks for each. Use this to research how a meme has evolved or to find variants of a known image.

tools.name: search_text_in_image
tools.description: Search for images by the text written or printed in them (OCR). Different from regular search — only matches the text_in_image field, not captions or tags. Use this to find screenshots of specific quotes, signs, watermarks, or memes with specific embedded text.

tools.name: find_meme_for_text
tools.description: Find a meme that captures a vibe, idea, or concept. Returns ready-to-embed images with citation blocks. Use this when writing posts, articles, or social content and you need a meme to illustrate a point.

tools.name: popular_tags
tools.description: List the most-used tags on MemeStack by all-time usage count. (Time-period filtering is not yet supported — tag usage is currently counted across the full lifetime of each tag.)

tools.name: tag_autocomplete
tools.description: Suggest tag slugs matching a prefix. Use this to verify a tag exists before filtering by it, or to discover related tags. Prefix must be ≥ 2 characters.

tools.name: cite_image
tools.description: Generate canonical attribution blocks for one or more MemeStack images. Returns markdown, HTML, and plain-text citation strings ready to paste into your output, plus a combined block for citing multiple images at once.

tools.name: reverse_image_search
tools.description: Find MemeStack images that look visually similar to a given image. Accepts an HTTPS image URL or a `data:image/...;base64,...` URL for bytes pasted into agent context. Returns visually-similar matches via perceptual-hash (dHash) hamming distance, with citation blocks. Heavily rate-limited (10/min/IP

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "list_categories" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: List all available image categories. Use this to discover what categories exist before calling browse_by_category.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "submit_image" is 1017 chars, far longer than this server's median (151). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "submit_image" stacks urgency/override words (important, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_images, get_image, reverse_image_search · Private data: submit_image · Public sink: submit_image.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_images, get_image, reverse_image_search · Private data: submit_image · Public sink: submit_image

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
